findings.evidence: 6 of the displayed top 25 rows use a player week earlier than selected Week 18.
findings.impact: The Week 18 discovery feed mixes stale changes from earlier weeks into the ranking.
findings.likely_cause: observable_changes takes each player-team-family's latest row at or before the selected week without requiring equality.
findings.proposed_fix: Require current.week == selected week before ranking.

findings.evidence: 791 player/case reconciliations fail against zero-inclusive eligible-game denominators.
findings.impact: Shares can be inflated and game samples understated when a qualifying player records zero selected opportunities.
findings.likely_cause: Player-week rows are created from numerator events only.
findings.proposed_fix: Start from eligible player-game rows and left join numerator counts, filling zero.

findings.evidence: 71 displayed situational shares disagree with complete same-context team-event denominators.
findings.impact: Situational shares can be inflated when a team has context opportunities but no opportunity credited to the selected position family in that game.
findings.likely_cause: The situational extract has no family row for a zero-family-numerator game, so that game's team denominator disappears when weeks are summed.
findings.proposed_fix: Build situational denominators from the full eligible team-game-context spine before joining family/player numerators.

findings.evidence: 3 situational reports return identical Normal game and All plays results.
findings.impact: The visible context filter does not describe the calculation for situational reports.
findings.likely_cause: league_situational_summary is called without intersecting the selected normal-game context.
findings.proposed_fix: Apply the selected all-play/normal-game filter to situational source rows or disable and relabel the control.

findings.evidence: Invalid player queries silently select the first player; Teams ignores team query parameters.
findings.impact: A malformed or stale link can show a valid but wrong entity without warning.
findings.likely_cause: Query values are used only when present in current options; no invalid-state branch exists, and Teams has no query parsing.
findings.proposed_fix: Add explicit invalid-entity states and a documented team URL contract.

findings.evidence: 5 sampled multi-team players have a selector team that differs from the latest team.
findings.impact: The selector can name the former team while the selected profile summary names the current team.
findings.likely_cause: drop_duplicates(player_id) keeps the first season row for selector labels.
findings.proposed_fix: Use latest-week identity for selector labels and retain week-level team attribution in logs.

findings.evidence: Home displays team text but renders no team link; Teams has no query-parameter URL contract.
findings.impact: Requested cross-page team navigation cannot be validated or used.
findings.proposed_fix: Add documented team deep links in a later authorized correctness-fix phase.

findings.evidence: Source schedules contain scores, and situational data contains inside-five counts, but the page does not display them; one-play production share is not implemented.
findings.impact: Several requested game facts cannot be checked in the public box score.
findings.likely_cause: The committed public game view intentionally omits schedule scores and several advanced fields.
findings.proposed_fix: Backlog the missing factual fields without changing definitions during Phase A.

findings.evidence: Live browser QA recorded no console errors but repeated Vega infinite-extent warnings for empty chart series.
findings.impact: No incorrect value was observed, but empty or sparse chart states generate noisy diagnostics and may render inconsistently.
findings.likely_cause: An empty series is still passed to the chart scale without an explicit empty-state branch.
findings.proposed_fix: Add an explicit no-series chart state in a later authorized correctness-fix phase.

limitations: The committed opportunity-event extract is the independent play-level source used for share contexts.
Raw PBP and schedules are referenced through the recorded build-manifest source path and hashed.
Game score and one-play production share are not displayed by the deployed page.
